**Overview:** This is a $486,000 conventional 30-year fixed purchase loan for Elena Ortega on property located at 3714 Station St, Millbrook, OH 43065, with a target closing date of 2026-12-04. All primary compliance checks have passed; however, the file remains in conditional approval status with two outstanding conditions that must be satisfied prior to clearing to close.

**Outstanding Conditions:**

- **Application/Employment Documentation:** Verbal verification of employment (VVOE) is required within 10 business days of the 2026-12-04 closing date. Recommend ordering VVOE from Ardentide Foods Co no later than 2026-11-20 to satisfy this condition.

- **Application/Property Documentation:** HOA dues statement must be provided, or borrower must confirm in writing that the property at 3714 Station St, Millbrook, OH 43065 is not part of an HOA. Recommend requesting clarification and documentation from the borrower or title company immediately.
